#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Image reader validation: canonical images accepted, mutations rejected."""
import os, subprocess, sys
BIN = '/work/submit/planb64'
T = '/work/tmp/w4'; os.makedirs(T, exist_ok=True)
ok = 0; bad = []
trace = os.path.join(T, 'tr.txt')
open(trace, 'w').write("::\n2001:db8::\n2001:db8:1::\nffff::\n")

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run([BIN] + args, capture_output=True)

def case(name, text, expect_ok, expect_out=None):
    global ok
    p = os.path.join(T, 'm.idx')
    with open(p, 'wb') as f: f.write(text if isinstance(text, bytes) else text.encode())
    r = run([BIN, 'lookup', p, trace, 'scalar'])
    if expect_ok:
        if r.returncode != 0 or r.stderr != b'':
            bad.append((name, r.returncode, r.stderr[:70])); return
        if expect_out is not None and r.stdout != expect_out:
            bad.append((name, 'stdout', r.stdout[:60], expect_out[:60])); return
        # batch must agree
        r2 = run([BIN, 'lookup', p, trace, 'batch', '2'])
        if r2.returncode != 0 or r2.stdout != r.stdout:
            bad.append((name, 'batch-mismatch')); return
        ok += 1
    else:
        if r.returncode != 2 or r.stdout != b'' or not r.stderr.startswith(b'ERROR:'):
            bad.append((name, r.returncode, r.stdout[:40], r.stderr[:70])); return
        ok += 1

BASE = "PLANB64 1\n2\n0000000000000000 7 0\n20010db800000000 20 32\n"
case('base', BASE, True, b"7 0\n7 0\n20 32\n7 0\n")
case('empty-img', "PLANB64 1\n1\n0000000000000000 -1 -1\n", True, b"-1 -1\n" * 4)
case('single-match', "PLANB64 1\n1\n0000000000000000 4294967295 64\n", True,
     b"4294967295 64\n" * 4)
case('top-row', "PLANB64 1\n2\n0000000000000000 -1 -1\nffffffffffffffff 1 64\n", True,
     b"-1 -1\n-1 -1\n-1 -1\n1 64\n")
case('max-rows-ok', "PLANB64 1\n3\n0000000000000000 -1 -1\n" +
     "%016x 1 64\n" % (2**64 - 2) + "%016x 2 64\n" % (2**64 - 1), True)

# ---- header
for h in ["PLANB64 2\n", "planb64 1\n", "PLANB64  1\n", "PLANB64 1 \n", "PLANB64\n",
          " PLANB64 1\n", "PLANB641\n", "PLANB64 1\r\n", "XPLANB64 1\n", ""]:
    case('hdr:' + h[:12], h + BASE.split('\n', 1)[1], False)
# ---- count line
for c in ["0\n", "01\n", "2 \n", " 2\n", "-2\n", "+2\n", "2.0\n", "x\n", "\n",
          "400002\n", "99999999999999999999\n", "3\n", "1\n"]:
    case('cnt:' + c[:8], "PLANB64 1\n" + c + "0000000000000000 7 0\n20010db800000000 20 32\n", False)
case('cnt-400001', "PLANB64 1\n400001\n" + "0000000000000000 -1 -1\n", False)  # count mismatch
# ---- rows
good_rows = ["0000000000000000 7 0", "20010db800000000 20 32"]
mut = {
 'shortkey': "000000000000000 7 0",
 'longkey': "00000000000000000 7 0",
 'upperhex': "000000000000000A 7 0",
 'nonhex': "000000000000000g 7 0",
 'nospace': "0000000000000000  7 0",
 'tabspace': "0000000000000000\t7 0",
 'leadspace': " 0000000000000000 7 0",
 'trailspace': "0000000000000000 7 0 ",
 'dblmid': "0000000000000000 7  0",
 'hopneg0': "0000000000000000 -0 0",
 'hopplus': "0000000000000000 +7 0",
 'hoplead0': "0000000000000000 07 0",
 'hopbig': "0000000000000000 4294967296 0",
 'hophuge': "0000000000000000 99999999999 0",
 'lenbig': "0000000000000000 7 65",
 'lenlead0': "0000000000000000 7 00",
 'lenplus': "0000000000000000 7 +0",
 'onesided1': "0000000000000000 -1 0",
 'onesided2': "0000000000000000 7 -1",
 'onesided3': "0000000000000000 -1 64",
 'emptyhop': "0000000000000000  0",
 'emptylen': "0000000000000000 7 ",
 'cr': "0000000000000000 7 0\r",
 'short': "0000000000000000 7",
 'blank': "",
 'junk': "0000000000000000 7 0junk",
 'hexlen': "0000000000000000 7 0x0",
}
for k, v in mut.items():
    case('row:' + k, "PLANB64 1\n2\n" + v + "\n20010db800000000 20 32\n", False)
# first key nonzero
case('firstkey', "PLANB64 1\n2\n0000000000000001 7 0\n20010db800000000 20 32\n", False)
# unordered / duplicate keys
case('unordered', "PLANB64 1\n2\n20010db800000000 20 32\n0000000000000000 7 0\n", False)
case('dupkey', "PLANB64 1\n2\n0000000000000000 7 0\n0000000000000000 8 0\n", False)
# equal adjacent pairs
case('eqpair', "PLANB64 1\n2\n0000000000000000 7 0\n20010db800000000 7 0\n", False)
case('eqpair2', "PLANB64 1\n2\n0000000000000000 -1 -1\n20010db800000000 -1 -1\n", False)
# missing final newline
case('nonl', BASE.rstrip('\n'), False)
case('nonl2', "PLANB64 1\n1\n0000000000000000 -1 -1", False)
# extra records / blank lines
case('extra', BASE + "20010db800010000 30 48\n", False)
case('extrablank', BASE + "\n", False)
case('blankmid', "PLANB64 1\n\n2\n0000000000000000 7 0\n20010db800000000 20 32\n", False)
case('blankbetween', "PLANB64 1\n3\n0000000000000000 7 0\n\n20010db800000000 20 32\n", False)
case('trailingnl2', BASE + "\n", False)
# fewer rows than declared
case('fewer', "PLANB64 1\n3\n0000000000000000 7 0\n20010db800000000 20 32\n", False)
# empty file
case('emptyfile', "", False)
# len 64 and hop max valid
case('len64', "PLANB64 1\n1\n0000000000000000 4294967295 64\n", True)
# no-match then match with same hop value as -1? not possible; hop 0 len 0 valid
case('hop0len0', "PLANB64 1\n1\n0000000000000000 0 0\n", True, b"0 0\n" * 4)
# binary junk
case('binary', b"PLANB64 1\n1\n\x00\x00\x00\n", False)
print("ok:", ok, "bad:", len(bad))
for b in bad: print("  FAIL", b)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PYEOF
